plain_english_policy: This bill establishes a broad religious and moral exemption framework in Alabama's healthcare system for private/denominational hospitals and their employees. It prohibits mandatory participation in six contentious medical practices—abortion, abortifacient drugs, embryonic stem cell research, cloning, euthanasia, or assisted suicide—by requiring that: (1) hospitals cannot be forced to provide facilities for these procedures; (2) healthcare workers cannot be compelled to perform or assist in them if they object on ethical/moral/religious grounds; and (3) no employment conditions can hinge on participation. Violations trigger civil lawsuits for damages or reinstatement.

evidence_quotes: No private or denominational hospital shall be required to permit its facilities... for abortions, human embryonic stem cell research, ... euthanasia, or physician-assisted suicide.
No physician... shall be required to perform... abortion,... euthanasia,... if that individual objects on ethical, moral, or religious grounds.
